[[Academy Monk]]s are trained by the [[Ascalon Academy]], the current and future healers for the [[Ascalon Army]]. In pre-Searing Ascalon, they're often found guarding [[resurrection shrine]]s, especially in hostile areas.

==Notes==
*All of the Academy Monks are female, and have a [[sword]] and [[shield]] equipped.
*Their rank in Divine Favor and Healing Prayers is much higher than player characters of the same level (which only have 20 attribute points, equivalent to rank 4 in both attributes). Without any rune, a player would need to be level 11 to meet the same rank.
*Their priority is to heal allies. They will follow an injured ally no matter how far, as long as the injured ally is being targeted by the Academy Monk and requires healing.
*They are hostile to a number of mobs, including devourers, elementals, skales and restless corpses.
* [[Green Hills County]] is the only explorable area in pre-Searing Ascalon without an Academy Monk standing by at one of the resurrection shrines.
** The shrine outside Ascalon City in Lakeside County is tended to by [[Lina the Healer]], a named academy monk.
